caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden piece of furniture resembling a desk or table, displayed against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or decorations. The furniture has a reddish-brown color, indicating a wood grain texture. It stands on four straight, vertically-oriented legs. The structure has a curved upper section that rises with an arch-like back and drops in the middle, forming a semicircular or dome-like contour at the top. The tabletop is an elongated oval with two rounded extensions on either side. Some faint, linear details suggest paneling or edges on the front and sides. The bottom right corner of the paper contains the artist's signature, "Henry Meyers," written in small, neat letters.
title: Card Table
